description: What Umbraco provides for keeping a package secure, on the server and in the backoffice: Management API authorization and policies, settings that hold secrets, endpoints outside the Management API, sanitizeHTML and escapeHTML, DOMPurify rules for custom elements, and umbHttpClient instead of handling tokens in the browser. Use when writing or reviewing a Management API controller, a secret setting, a custom endpoint, a backoffice template that uses unsafeHTML, or frontend code that calls an API.
